mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in monthly job growth (PAYEMS crossing above 140,000) triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days as strong labor demand boosts corporate profits and market sentiment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when PAYEMS crosses above 140,000

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly demand growth (GDPC1 exceeding 14,000) signals robust consumer and business activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when GDPC1 exceeds 14,000

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rates (<1%) and unemployment rates (<5%) indicate loose monetary policy, compressing risk premiums and lifting S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive when both proxies remain below thresholds

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the supply index (INDPRO exceeding 105) signals overproduction, leading to S&P 500 forward returns falling by -1% over 20 trading days as market adjusts to excess inventory.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not negative when INDPRO crosses above 105

mechanism_narrative: High demand growth (GDPC1 >14,000) and supply growth (INDPRO >105) jointly signal overheating, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as market corrects valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not negative when both proxies exceed thresholds

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS >2% AND UNRATE >6%) reduces liquidity, elevating risk aversion and driving S&P 500 forward returns down by -1.5% over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2% AND UNRATE crosses above 6%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not negative when in tightening regime

mechanism_narrative: A sudden jump in quarterly demand (GDPC1 crossing above 14,000) triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days as investors anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positive when GDPC1 crosses above 14,000
